thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Real-time SLO alert triggered for prod-east (p99 > 1.2s). Alert id: RBW-9091. Paging carol-oncall and ops-pager. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod-east/slo?p=RBW-9091

carol-oncall: on it. pulling up p95/p99 charts now. can someone drop the realtime logs link?

ben-platform: https://logs.redwood/prod-east?query=latency%20>1000ms — seeing a spike starting 2495012290, correlates with increased streaming open connections.

emily-sre: I see p95 -> 340ms, p99 -> 1.34s on the 1m window. error rate steady. tail latency spikes coincide with a small bump in queue length for model-serving pods.

carol-oncall: ok quick checklist: 1) confirm customer impact 2) check autoscale & pod health 3) consider fallback routing to smaller model 4) notify CS if customer-visible

dinesh-prod: customer impact: slowdowns for streaming responses >1s for ~3% of requests. a few clients reported timeouts. marking impacted=true in incident tracker.

ops-pager: acknowledging. i'll take infra checks. carol, want me to scale?

carol-oncall: yes - run a scale-up on model-deploy-prod-east-bert-heavy. try +3 replicas for now.

ops-pager: running:```bash
kubectl scale deploy/model-deploy-prod-east-bert-heavy --replicas=8 -n prod
# result: Scaling deployment "model-deploy-prod-east-bert-heavy" to 8 replicas
```

ben-platform: autoscaler logs show it had paused because of a control-plane transient. looks like HPA didn't kick between 2495012200-2495012320. manually scaled.

emily-sre: after scale - p95 down to ~260ms, p99 -> 780ms within 90s. streaming stall events reduced.

sara-eng: any config changes upstream? release window was 2495012100 but no model changes. maybe a traffic pattern shift — traffic to long-context endpoint increased ~2x.

carol-oncall: good mitigations. next actions: 1) verify no degraded checksum/log errors 2) enable interim routing policy to route new streaming connections to fallback-small-model if queue > 200

ben-platform: adding a route override in envoy:```json
{"match": {"path": "/stream"}, "route": "model-small", "conditions": {"queue_length_gt": 200}}
```applied via rollout manager.

incident-bot: action logged: route-override applied by ben-platform at 2495012405.

dinesh-prod: pushing a short customer advisory draft to #customer-notify — can someone approve? example: "We detected transient latency on streaming endpoints in prod-east from 09:27-09:34 UTC; we mitigated by scaling and routing fallbacks. Some customers may have seen timeouts. We're investigating root cause."

carol-oncall: looks good, pls include that we've started a postmortem and will share timeline. emily can you confirm SLOs are back?

emily-sre: p99 now stable at ~510ms over 5m window, p95 210ms. within SLO (p99 target 600ms). flagging for another 10m watch.

ops-pager: infra note: one model pod showed OOM events right before the spike. kubectl describe pod/model-deploy-prod-east-bert-heavy-6f4b shows: "OOMKilled" at 2495012285. logs include large KV cache growth.

ben-platform: logging snapshot from that pod:```
[2495012278] INFO kv_cache: size=1.9GB
[2495012281] WARN mem: approaching node alloc threshold
[2495012285] ERROR process: OOMKilled
```

sara-eng: KV cache growth + long-context traffic seems plausible root cause. we should cap kv_cache per-shard or use eviction policy. adding a ticket.

carol-oncall: decision: short-term mitigation = keep route-override active and increase replica count to avoid single-pod OOM impact. medium-term = enforce per-request KV limits and patch model runtime to evict aggressively. assign to sara-eng and ben-platform.

ops-pager: scaling further to 10 replicas and bumping node pool autoscaler min to handle surge.```bash
kubectl scale deploy/model-deploy-prod-east-bert-heavy --replicas=10 -n prod
cloudctl nodepools resize --min=3 --cluster=prod-east
```

emily-sre: monitoring: no new OOMs after scale. p99 stable ~480-520ms. starting 10m quiet period.

carol-oncall: handoff plan: i'm on-call til 10:00; after that ben-platform will take follow-up for the postmortem. if p99 breaches again, page ops-pager and escalate to eng-ml.

ben-platform: acknowledged. I'll take postmortem and patch work. already created ticket RBW-9091-PO for KV cap and eviction policy. linking runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/latency-triage

incident-bot: Incident RBW-9091 status=mitigated (p99<=SLO). duration ~6m. pages resolved. Please update incident tracker with timeline and owners.

carol-oncall: quick notes for tracker: start=2495012290 alert; manual scale=2495012370; route-override=2495012405; scale to 10=2495012432; mitigated=2495012450. assigning postmortem to ben-platform, owner for runtime fix sara-eng.

dinesh-prod: customer comms sent at 2495012500. no further customer escalations.

sara-eng: I'll draft the fix PR with KV cap and add a config flag for per-request kv_limit. ETA EOD.

emily-sre: leaving final note: watch window complete, all metrics green. recommend blameless postmortem with action items: HPA resilience, KV cache caps, route fallback testing.

carol-oncall: thanks team. closing thread here unless something pops. :thumbsup:
